text:
oliver: ops-bot alert: sustained contbatch latency surge + KV cache eviction storm in ap-south. paging.fetch_errors spiking. :rotating_light:
meera.k: i'm oncall, taking it. pulling up traces and alert context. initial spike started ~6m after config push from pipeline.
derek_o: saw retries and a lot of `kvcache: page pressure` logs. sequences per-batch jumped unexpectedly. this smells like max_batch_tokens ballooning.
opsbot: Config change detected by CI: contbatch.global.max_batch_tokens=12000 applied at 3720000310 (deploy id d-3720000310).
jonah: we also have a new model wrapper (wrap-v3) rolled to a subset of workers around the same time. could be interacting with batching heuristics.
meera.k: customers showing errors: two medium accounts report repeated truncated streams and elevated 504s. logging request ids for support. sara_support, can you confirm customer impact?
sara_support: confirmed, opened CS-12044 and CS-12047; customers seeing ~15-20% failure rate on streaming when this hit. notified account reps. drafting short status update.
oliver: quick mitigation plan: 1) cap max_batch_tokens down to 2048, 2) set max_num_seqs=4 for ap-south contbatch pool, 3) temporarily disable aggressive prefetch in wrap-v3, 4) throttle new ingress to ap-south to avoid overloading backend while queues drain.
meera.k: applying (will do in that order). running commands:
```
redwoodctl config set contbatch.global.max_batch_tokens=2048 --env prod
redwoodctl config set contbatch.pool.ap-south.max_num_seqs=4 --env prod
redwoodctl config set models.wrap-v3.prefetch.enabled=false --env prod
redwoodctl route throttle ap-south --rate 1200rps --env prod
```
infra-bot: Rolling config change requested by meera.k (change id c-3720004321).
derek_o: watching metrics: kvcache.evictions/min down from ~520 -> 80 within 3m. paging.fetch_errors decreasing. p95 latency from 3.6s -> 590ms.
jonah: to avoid regression, we should also add a hard runtime safeguard: reject batches that exceed 8k tokens and emit an alert if that happens. create followup ticket.
meera.k: agree. adding runbook entry and a CI canary for contbatch config changes. also enabling a combined alert (kvcache.evictions>200 AND paging.backlog>40k).
oliver: support update: customers acknowledge improvement, one requests full logs for recent failed requests. sara_support to send the logs and follow up.
sara_support: sending logs to acct teams and prepping a customer-facing timeline if we confirm RCA.
derek_o: root cause notes in thread: 1) pipeline default changed max_batch_tokens to 12k for wrap-v3 canary which accidentally rolled to all workers in ap-south, 2) wrap-v3 prefetch increases estimated seq_length leading to oversized batches, 3) no canary gate for contbatch config diffs -> immediate blast radius.
meera.k: created PM ticket INC-372000-RCA and attached logs and the timeline. immediate action items assigned: (oliver) lock down pipeline default to conservative batch size, (jonah) add wrap-v3 canary config that restricts prefetch, (derek_o) implement runtime hard cap and emergency kvcache guard, (sara_support) finalize customer comms.
opsbot: On-call handover requested: meera.k -> derek_o in 45m :bell:
jonah: i'll prepare a small test-suite to simulate high avg_seq_length and confirm we don't re-introduce compaction thrash.
meera.k: monitoring continues. leaving this thread open until we've had a 2h stable window. tagging postmortem owner and will schedule RCA meeting. :calendar:
